criteria.evidence: Opens with "Start with whether you need to migrate" and notes a two-function direct-API agent is already simple; assesses actual complexity and need before recommending anything.
criteria.criterion: Evaluate the actual complexity and requirement.

criteria.evidence: Recommends staying on the direct API for two functions; if migrating, "keep it small", swap only the model call, and use a plain loop as the lightest orchestration instead of a prebuilt agent.
criteria.criterion: Prefer a simpler implementation when sufficient.

criteria.evidence: Lists specific gaps that justify migrating: provider switching, tracing/retries/memory, growth to many tools or branching workflows, team standardization; and says to migrate only if one applies.
criteria.criterion: Explain what evidence would justify adding a framework.
